notes: No C++ AC in the corpus. orig.cpp follows the official editorial: greedy prefix, then the lexicographically smallest perfect matching on the last positions (the suffix doubles if the prefix leaves no matching). It matches a lexicographic backtracking brute force for N <= 19 and odd N <= 61, the plain lexicographic matching over all N positions for every N <= 700, and its output is a valid prime-sum permutation at N = 1e6 and N = 674871.
